name: io.github.Servosity/domain-cert-tracker-mcp
title: Domain and Certificate Tracker MCP
description: Every client's domains and certificates in one inventory: what expires, unlocks or changes.

environmentVariables.name: DOMAIN_CERT_TRACKER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional server for single lookups. Leave the default; sweep always routes each domain to its registry. A server named here is reached even on a private address or another port.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: DOMAIN_CERT_TRACKER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call.

environmentVariables.name: DOMAIN_CERT_TRACKER_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local store or response cache; sweep is then refused.

environmentVariables.name: DOMAIN_CERT_TRACKER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends to RDAP servers and crt.sh.

environmentVariables.name: DOMAIN_CERT_TRACKER_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
